what: Key evidence now classifies the stroke as cryptogenic, likely PFO-associated (large shunt, RoPE 9), with paradoxical embolism probable not established (no venous thrombus documented; a venous source is not required for attribution or closure). The label already says 'most likely paradoxical embolism' and is kept, as R1 asks; no criterion requires DVT imaging.

The aspirin must and the drug-check warning now individualise the timing after reviewing the stability of the HI-1 transformation, neurological status and bleeding risk; HI-1 does not automatically contraindicate it.

Class LDL (ruling 7): the LDL < 70 mg/dL target removed from the statin must of the five non-atherosclerotic cases (P01, RM04 vertebral dissection; RM01 carotid dissection; P05, RP03 PFO); the must now reads 'Consider atorvastatin 80 mg' and states that the target applies to atherosclerotic disease. Cardioembolic cases with documented carotid or aortic atherosclerosis keep it.
